US and Iran exchange strikes amid Strait of Hormuz tensions

The United States and Iran have engaged in retaliatory strikes following a drone attack on a cargo ship near the Strait of Hormuz. Iran launched missiles at US infrastructure in Kuwait and Bahrain, while the US conducted strikes on targets within Iran. These exchanges have raised concerns about a potential ceasefire and peace talks between the two nations.
